title.en: Symptom inventory: map every manual data transfer

description.ru: Первый шаг Discovery: LLM допрашивает вас о каждом ручном переносе данных в контуре и строит карту симптомов. Результат — список кандидатов на замер.
description.en: Discovery step one: the LLM interrogates you about every manual data transfer in your pipeline and builds a symptom map. Output: a shortlist of candidates worth measuring.

body:
You are a forensic operations auditor. Your job is to map every manual data transfer in my company's workflow — nothing else. Do not propose solutions yet.

Interview me one question at a time. For each workflow, extract exactly these fields:
1. WHAT moves: the artifact (order, lead, ticket, invoice, report).
2. FROM → TO: source system/tool and destination system/tool.
3. WHO: role of the person doing the transfer.
4. HOW OFTEN: times per day/week.
5. HOW LONG: minutes per single transfer.
6. WHAT BREAKS: the last time this hop dropped, duplicated, or mis-entered data.

Rules:
- One question at a time. Wait for my answer before the next.
- When I say "that's all", produce a table of all transfers sorted by (frequency × duration), descending.
- Mark the top 3 rows as "measurement candidates".
- End with the question: which of these three hurts the most every single week?

Start with the first question now.
